description:
Queue an iap.test event to the store's webhook, to check the endpoint receives and verifies deliveries. See the result with iap_get_webhook. Store key scope: events:read.

Params: store_id, session_token?, idempotency_key?
Returns: {ok, idempotency_key, queued: true, event: {id, type: 'iap.test', createdAt, data}}
Errors: NO_CREDENTIALS, IAP_PLAN_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND (no webhook set)

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency-Key for this write. Omit to generate one; reuse the returned idempotency_key to retry safely

session_token.description: Session token from authenticate. Optional when CHAINDADDY_API_KEY is set (or, for store-scoped tools, CHAINDADDY_IAP_KEY)

name: iap_test_webhook
title: Send a test webhook
